anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved f1 and f3 by reading the `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` helper result as the `Helper open - needs <what>` obstacle row before the watch guard, rendering an explicit `Obstacle: stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` line and the shared obstacle template (eligible numeric deliver with the +6/+6 cumulative extension and the note that an unchanged prerequisite exits again, assess, stop recommended last, evidence as a hint, no fix/wait rows). Before already satisfied f2 (no watch, no helper re-dispatch), and After preserves that: the exit check fires before `gh pr checks --watch`, no deadline is minted, no helper runs, and the re-render reads are all read-only. Nothing regressed; keep the wording that places the exit check ahead of the watch guard on own-push re-entry, names the prerequisite without CI-timeout qualification, and states that cap extension alone does not clear a failed prerequisite.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: All three facts moved from fails to holds, exactly as intended. Before never treated the unchanged `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` result as an obstacle: it read the retained course as granting no authority, rendered an ordinary fixable menu with a `wait` row and a recommended `fix` row, and so there was no obstacle report at all for f2 to attach to. After evaluates the helper prerequisite first (step 3), exits `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` before any watch, sync, verification or implementer dispatch, leaves both counters and the poll deadline untouched, and renders the obstacle menu with numeric deliver and assess, stop recommended and last, no fix/wait rows, and the deliver row explicitly conditioned on the prerequisite changing rather than on the +6 extension alone. Nothing in After regressed a fact Before kept. One small tightening worth considering: the report line 'The course is stuck - needs ...' reads as if course were a state rather than `deliver`; phrasing it as 'Obstacle: stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff (course deliver retained)' would keep the retained-course claim in step 2 and the exit reason unambiguous in the same rendering.
